changeSet.author: paradox-devs
changeSet.createView: SELECT t.id, t.name, t.description, t.currency, t.amount, t.transaction_date, c.name AS transaction_category_name, c.transaction_type AS transaction_type, u1.username AS created_by_username, t.created_at, u2.username AS updated_by_username, t.updated_at FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN users u1 ON t.created_by = u1.uuid LEFT JOIN users u2 ON t.updated_by = u2.uuid LEFT JOIN transaction_categories c ON t.transaction_category_id = c.id
